(1) dopamine receptors in the subthalamnus nucleus (STN) set the pattern of background neuronal activity; (2) the pattern of background activity is different in the normal and dopamine‐deficient state; (3) the different patterns of background activity are due to the different effects of the two dopamine receptor families on the excitability of STN neurons.
